settings.reset.title: Restore default settings
settings.reset.prompt:
Restore the built-in defaults for “{title}”?

This immediately overwrites {file_key}.json and discards unsaved edits in this category. Other categories, logs and data are unaffected. This cannot be automatically undone.
settings.reset.failed: Restore failed. Original settings are unchanged: {detail}
settings.reset.done: Defaults restored and saved for this category. Window size and startup page take effect next launch.
settings.open.done: Requested the configuration folder for {file_key}.json. Restart the app after editing files manually.
settings.open.failed: Cannot open the folder. Copy the path above to access {file_key}.json manually.
